senses.gloss: m. (= גנזא; גנז; fr. which γάζα) treasure, collection. בי ג׳־ treasury.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 63a">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>ומשתכחא בי ג׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. <he>בְּגַזָּאֵי</he>) it is found in the treasury (among the collections) of queen &c.
<cite ref="Yoma 51a">Yoma 51ᵃ</cite> <he>בי ג׳ דאהרן</he> Aaron’s (the Highpriest’s) fund.

<cite ref="Horayot 9a:3">Hor. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>דיליך או דג׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>דידיך דג׳</he>, insert <cite ref="A00516"><he>או</he></cite>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) from thy (the Highpriest’s) private money or from the fund?—
<cite ref="Meilah 17b">Meïl. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>עולו לבי ג׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>עיילינהו לגניזה</he>) go ye into the treasury (he took them to &c.).

<cite ref="Chullin 139a:18">Ḥull. 139ᵃ</cite> wherever the vowed sacrifice stands, <he>בבי ג׳ דרחמנא וכ׳</he> it is in the Lord’s treasury (it is to be considered as if its delivery had taken place).—[<he>גִּזָּא</he> <cite ref="Berakhot 40a">Ber. 40ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Berakhot 40b">40ᵇ</cite> Ar., v. <cite ref="C00328"><he>גַּוָּוזָא</he> I</cite>.]
